tasks.title: Route storage refunds through typed owners and conservation
tasks.acceptance: Typed identity/contract-bucket recorded refund ownership and historical fee decoding. tasks.acceptance: Contracts may parameterize contested indexes only through supported native declarations. T01.title: Ordinary key/value trees
T01.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare a contract-owned ordinary collection; create/read/insert/replace/delete through typed host handles.

**Rules/checks:** NormalTree and Item. Namespace, allowed value types and key codec must be fixed; reject forged paths and non-empty subtree replacement. Verify inclusion and absence.

**Cost drivers:** Key/value bytes, depth, affected ancestors. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T02.title: Signed sum trees
T02.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare a summed integer contribution; host maintains SumItem or ItemWithSumItem on writes; expose total.

**Rules/checks:** SumTree. Checked signed arithmetic; changing a value removes its old contribution and adds its new one. Whole-tree totals do not imply logarithmic range-sum proofs.

**Cost drivers:** Integer width, write fan-out, ancestors. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T03.title: Large sum trees
T03.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare BigSumTree when wider totals are needed; expose exact integer encoding.

**Rules/checks:** BigSumTree uses a 256-bit aggregate, not a new unrestricted monetary supply type. Verify overflow and client lossless conversion; no automatic range-sum proof promise.

**Cost drivers:** Large-integer arithmetic and encoding bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T04.title: Count trees
T04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare countable documents/indexes; insert/delete maintain count; read total.

**Rules/checks:** CountTree counts contributions, which may be subtree counts rather than one per returned row. Test nested trees, empty branches and non-counted continuations.

**Cost drivers:** Changed branches and query traversal. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T05.title: Combined count/sum trees
T05.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04, CAP-18.

**Declare/do:** Declare both countability and a required integer sum field; maintain both with each document mutation.

**Rules/checks:** CountSumTree; return count and sum from the same view. Update of only the summed field leaves count unchanged. Reject overflow atomically.

**Cost drivers:** Both aggregates and every affected index. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T06.title: Provable count trees

**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare range countability; support authenticated range counts and eligible offset queries.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountTree binds counts in the hash. Prove requested boundaries, empty ranges and page offsets; reject offset shapes where a row contributes multiple count units.

**Cost drivers:** Boundary traversal, proof bytes and skipped-count checks. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

**Cost drivers:** Count proof plus ordinary sum maintenance. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

T09.title: Provable count and provable sum trees
T09.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare both range metrics; expose a single count/sum result and derive averages outside consensus arithmetic.

## References

R01.title: Ordinary references and seven path forms
R01.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Declare permitted relations; resolve through bounded handles. Cover absolute, root-relative, parent-addition, element-relative, cousin, removed-cousin and sibling references.

**Rules/checks:** Validate resolved target namespace, hop limits, cycles, dangling targets and proofs. A relative path is not a permission grant. Ordinary references need explicit maintenance when targets change.

**Cost drivers:** Hops, path bytes, target reads and rewrites. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

**Rules/checks:** Recompute contribution from validated data; refresh target hashes on edits. Test changed target, same-batch moves and aggregate correctness.

**Cost drivers:** Reference hops plus sum/index update work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

R03.title: Bidirectional references
R03.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Declare automatic incoming-reference maintenance, capacity and cascade consent; offer only consistently flagged host mutations.

**Rules/checks:** GROVE_V4 feature. Target must support backrefs; max incoming <=256, native default32, depth<=32, chains<=10 and one incoming per reference. These are native bounds, not approved guest defaults. Enforce cross-contract consent for every derived write.

**Cost drivers:** Declared fan-out times chain/depth work, including registration and cleanup. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [adr/bidirectional_references.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/adr/bidirectional_references.md#L1)

R04.title: Back-reference targets and cascades
R04.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Support ItemWithBackwardsReferences, SumItemWithBackwardsReferences and ItemWithSumItemWithBackwardsReferences through the same relation declaration.

**Rules/checks:** No aggregate wrappers; Provable aggregate parents and V0 proofs reject this family. Every affected edge must consent to destructive cascade. Capacity cannot drop below registrations. Never accept raw incoming lists from guest code.

**Cost drivers:** Target growth, cascade deletes and refund owners. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [adr/bidirectional_references.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/adr/bidirectional_references.md#L1)

R05.title: Back-reference batch and lifecycle constraints
R05.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-06, CAP-14.

**Declare/do:** Select the native flagged full-batch path or validated live operation; keep incompatible clear/partial-batch operations out of this route.

**Rules/checks:** Partial batches and clear lack propagation support. Flagged batch refuses non-empty subtree deletion; flagged insert/delete rejects specialized/indexed trees. Unflagged overwrite/delete can break links, so prevent that escape route including wipe/migration. Test same-batch targets, conflicts and rollback.

**Cost drivers:** Expanded derived operations and worst-case bounds. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Declare the existing timeRange shape and expose its supported interval queries.

**Rules/checks:** Use native endpoint/grid/decomposition validation and bounds; test touching intervals, open/closed ends, duplicate results and malformed ranges. No wall-clock host dependency.

**Cost drivers:** Interval expansion, touched buckets and query union work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index/mod.rs#L434)

I10.title: Index-only document types
I10.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Declare indexOnly and terminal property; reconstruct documents from index entries.

**Rules/checks:** All properties required and indexed, owner recoverable, immutable/non-transferable/no history under current rules. Test exact reconstruction and forbidden updates; no phantom primary record.

**Cost drivers:** Terminal entries, reconstruction and response copies. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/v2/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/v2/mod.rs#L30)

I11.title: Terminal, preallocated and sparse indexes
I11.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Expose terminal, preallocated and skipIfAbsent according to native schema support.

**Rules/checks:** Validate terminal type, preallocation configuration and sparse missing-value behavior. Test false/zero versus absent, branch allocation, accounting and proof absence.

**Cost drivers:** Preallocated storage, allocated branches and skipped writes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index/mod.rs#L434)

I12.title: Shared-prefix index validation and migration
I12.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Reuse native IndexLevel construction, conflict validation and contract update/migration paths.

**Rules/checks:** Check prefix count/sum/wrapper compatibility, existing populated trees and cache refresh. Do not silently reinterpret populated storage under a new declaration.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index_level/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/index_level/mod.rs#L1)

## Queries and proofs

Q01.title: Point, optional and raw reads
Q01.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose typed get/exists/optional reads and explicitly authorized raw-element projections.

**Rules/checks:** Distinguish absent from wrong type/storage failure. Resolve or return references as declared; raw reads must not leak internal bookkeeping or bypass namespace permissions.

**Cost drivers:** Point reads, reference hops and returned bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/get/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/get/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q02.title: All key and range selectors
Q02.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Support Key and all nine native range boundary forms through canonical query builders.

**Rules/checks:** Test inclusive/exclusive endpoints, empty/full ranges, order and overlapping selectors; bounded full ranges remain subject to work/result caps.

**Cost drivers:** Ranges, seeks, visited rows and bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs#L49); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q03.title: Nested and conditional path queries
Q03.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Declare default/conditional branches and typed path descent.

**Rules/checks:** Validate query grammar and every resolved namespace, nested depth and branch count. Use unified native shape validation for run/prove/verify compatibility.

**Cost drivers:** Branch expansion, nesting and per-branch traversal. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query.rs#L16); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q04.title: Paging, direction and count offsets
Q04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose supported limit/offset/direction and continuation requests.

**Rules/checks:** No assumption all offsets are provable. Count-offset proofs require one count contribution per output row. Some(0) and None differ for some consumers; test exact semantics.

**Cost drivers:** Skipped rows or counts, emitted rows and proof size. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query.rs#L16); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q05.title: Per-instance query limits
Q05.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose nested per-instance limits once the matching query codec/protocol is integrated.

**Rules/checks:** GROVE_V4 wire v3 feature; effective budget is constrained by ancestors/global limit. Reject zero per-instance limit. Test sibling branch budgets and canonical decoding.

**Cost drivers:** Total visited work and nested limits. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query.rs#L16); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q06.title: Parent inclusion and result projections
Q06.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Choose whether the typed host supports add_parent_tree_on_subquery; expose supported key/item/sum/element projections.

**Rules/checks:** Included parent rows do not count toward ordinary row limits; independently bound total rows/bytes. Absence verification does not return those parent rows. Reject unsupported consumer combinations.

**Cost drivers:** Parents plus leaves, decoded values and repeated copies. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query.rs#L16); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q07.title: Range count proofs
Q07.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Expose aggregate count queries and their supported per-key carrier forms.

**Rules/checks:** Use the actual native query validator; scalar-leaf, carrier, offset and proof-envelope constraints differ. Test tampered counts, boundaries and empty groups.

**Cost drivers:** Aggregate boundary visits and proof bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs#L49); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q08.title: Range sum proofs
Q08.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Expose signed range sum queries with native tree/shape checks.

**Rules/checks:** Only a hash-binding sum layout supports the compact proof. Test negative contributions, overflow and zero/empty distinctions.

**Cost drivers:** Sum arithmetic, boundary visits and proof bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/query_item/mod.rs#L49); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q09.title: Combined count/sum and averages
Q09.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04, CAP-18.

**Declare/do:** Return a count/sum pair atomically; client may display an average.

**Rules/checks:** Require both compatible metrics. Specify zero-count representation and client rounding; do not separately query count and sum from different roots.

**Cost drivers:** Dual aggregate traversal and result encoding. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/query/drive_document_average_query/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/query/drive_document_average_query/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q10.title: Grouped aggregates and HAVING
Q10.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Expose native grouped/count/sum/HAVING query plans rather than arbitrary SQL.

**Rules/checks:** Validate available indexes and conditions, omitted missing outer groups versus zero empty inner aggregates, ordering and supported proof shapes.

**Cost drivers:** Groups examined, predicates and proof rows. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/query/drive_document_having_query/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/query/drive_document_having_query/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q11.title: Ranked pages and bounded axis reads
Q11.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Support RankedPage and Bounded on configured Count/Sum/Avg axes, ascending or descending.

**Rules/checks:** Native ties break by original key in traversal direction. Test equal averages, ties, offset, missing axis and changes between requests.

**Cost drivers:** Page/range size, secondary traversal and primary reads. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs#L417); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q12.title: Rank of key and aggregate over ranked values
Q12.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Expose RankOfKey and AggregateOverValueRange with Population/Total folds where supported.

**Rules/checks:** Return typed scalar/fold results; reject unsupported axis/fold combinations. Test absent keys, value boundaries, zero populations and sum budgets separately.

**Cost drivers:** Range proof traversal and scalar computation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs#L417); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q13.title: Axis keys-only projection
Q13.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Offer Keys or Entries for ranked listing reads.

**Rules/checks:** Keys skips primary value reads for unproved execution, but proofs still carry/authenticate primary entries. Do not underprice proofs using keys-only read costs.

**Cost drivers:** Projection-dependent primary reads plus full proof work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/axis_query.rs#L417); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q14.title: Sum-budget reads
Q14.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose a typed sum_limit and optional match_limit on native-supported shapes.

**Rules/checks:** Use ReadMode::SumBudget and its independent validation/proof gates. Test exact budget, under/over budget, match limit, excluded contributions and unsupported signed layouts.

**Cost drivers:** Visited elements, stopping boundaries and proof bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-query/src/read_mode.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-query/src/read_mode.rs#L130); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q15.title: Chained document queries
Q15.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose the existing reference-to-document-ID semijoin interface.

**Rules/checks:** Validate source/destination contracts, bounded references and target IDs, duplicates/missing values and one coherent current root; preserve guest read visibility.

**Cost drivers:** Source matches, relation fan-out and target reads. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/query/chained_document_query/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/query/chained_document_query/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q16.title: Composite document queries
Q16.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Expose supported joins/lookups/count components as a typed composite query.

**Rules/checks:** All components must bind to the same root; permission and byte/work bounds apply to every component. Reject malformed composition and mismatched roots.

**Cost drivers:** Component count, joins and combined proof size. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/query/composite_document_query/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/query/composite_document_query/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q17.title: Query canonicalization and encoding
Q17.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-05.

**Declare/do:** Route host builders, DAPI and verifiers through compatible native classification and versioned codecs.

**Rules/checks:** Run/prove/verify consumers have different capability gates; test canonical v1/v2/v3 queries, bounded untrusted decode, unsupported combinations and nested rejection.

**Cost drivers:** Encoded bytes, decode allocations and validation work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q18.title: Current-root inclusion, absence and subset proofs
Q18.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-12.

**Declare/do:** Expose typed current-state proofs for supported data, balances, code and receipts.

**Rules/checks:** Bind expected chain root, path, full request, effective limit and result type. Subset reuse is not universally valid; missing receipts do not prove execution outcome.

**Cost drivers:** Proof bytes, hashes, decoded nodes and response limits. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/proof/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/proof/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

Q19.title: Specialized tree and chunk proofs
Q19.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-12.

**Declare/do:** Use the corresponding commitment/MMR/bulk/dense/private/indexed proof format and verifier.

**Rules/checks:** Bind specialized root/config/count through parent state. V4 chunk fixes bind snapshot/rows; chunks containing indexed trees are refused. Do not silently downgrade unsupported proof requests.

**Cost drivers:** Chunk/range bytes and specialized verification work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/proof/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/proof/mod.rs#L1); [docs/query-validation.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/docs/query-validation.md#L1)

## Atomic operations and costs

A01.title: Atomic full batches and transaction ownership
A01.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Apply validated contract/native effects through existing GroveDB batches and the owning Platform transaction.

**Rules/checks:** Test primary/index/assets/history/receipts all-or-nothing on failure, nested calls and mixed native work. One atomic GroveDB call does not by itself specify nested contract rollback.

**Cost drivers:** Whole expanded batch and transaction memory. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A02.title: Insert-only, upsert, replace and patch
A02.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Expose operation intent through validated document/collection methods.

**Rules/checks:** Native InsertIfNotExists can error or skip; preserve distinction. Known-not-existing hints, byte-change hints and trusted payloads are supplied only by Drive after validation.

**Cost drivers:** Existence checks, old/new bytes and patch accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A03.title: Delete, subtree deletion and clearing
A03.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Provide permitted delete/clear intent with fixed host-owned deletion policy.

**Rules/checks:** Account for every descendant and refund owner; reject non-empty deletion when unsupported. DontCheckWithNoCleanup and DropFlat cannot become guest-selected accounting bypasses.

**Cost drivers:** Subtree size, cleanup, references and refunded bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A04.title: Move and query-selected batch operations
A04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Support native moves and bounded query-selected move/delete through typed authorized objects.

**Rules/checks:** Authorize both source and destination; preserve flags/index references and ownership. Test collisions, overlapping selections, same-batch reads and all-or-nothing effects.

**Cost drivers:** Selected rows, both paths and dependent index/reference work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs#L1)

A05.title: Conditional insertion and arithmetic helpers
A05.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Reuse if-changed, if-absent, return-existing and sum-item add/keep-item helpers for appropriate host intents.

**Rules/checks:** Guests cannot skip native affordability or overwrite contributions arbitrarily. Test existing/wrong-type entries, zero deltas, arithmetic overflow and operation ordering.

**Cost drivers:** Reads, changed bytes and arithmetic propagation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs#L1)

A06.title: Reference refresh modes
A06.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Drive chooses plain/sum reference refresh and trusted/untrusted mode after validated index planning.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve flags, path, wrapper and sum according to mode; trusted coercion is not a public guest option. RefreshReference on bidirectional participants must reject.

**Cost drivers:** Hop resolution and rewritten hashes/contributions. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A07.title: Partial batches and callback merging
A07.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Reuse only where native integration requires partial batches and cost callbacks.

**Rules/checks:** V4 merges/rejects callback collisions with pending ancestor updates. Test each tree family, cross-segment conflicts and old-version replay; backrefs have no partial expansion support.

**Cost drivers:** Both segments, callbacks and pending propagation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A08.title: Internal root propagation and secondary reconciliation
A08.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10, CAP-17.

**Declare/do:** Keep all root/hash replacement and aggregate-index secondary operations internal.

**Rules/checks:** Seven root/family propagation GroveOp variants are never guest requests. Test nested indexed changes and metadata retention; guest cannot forge root hashes.

**Cost drivers:** Ancestor paths, every secondary and specialized metadata. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A09.title: Batch consistency and host-owned options
A09.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Fix validation/propagation options in the protocol-selected host path.

**Rules/checks:** Keep duplicate/conflicting operation checks enabled; do not expose disable_consistency_check, free-root billing or pause height to guests. Include derived cascade conflicts.

**Cost drivers:** Validation of expanded operations and conflict lookups. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/options.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/options.rs#L12)

A10.title: Cost estimation, charging and storage refunds
A10.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-11.

**Declare/do:** Use existing average/worst-case/actual native costs plus metered guest work; signer pays direct calls and stored owner receives refunds.

**Rules/checks:** Full bound checked against live funds; actual charged once on success or paid failure. Reconcile hash/seek/load/add/replace/remove and history/reference/specialized work. Fee registry fix precedes infrastructure merges.

**Cost drivers:** Every native OperationCost dimension plus compute and wire copies. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/fees/op.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/fees/op.rs#L1)

A11.title: Storage flags and ownership epochs
A11.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-11.

**Declare/do:** Drive constructs and updates storage ownership/epoch flags and split refunds.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve old-owner historical refunds across edits/moves/wipes; no guest-supplied flags. Test shared flags, shrink/grow, epoch transitions and compound cascades.

**Cost drivers:** Flag bytes, removed-byte attribution and epoch accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/storage_flags.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/storage_flags.rs#L1)

A12.title: Protocol dispatch and GroveDB upgrade
A12.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-01, CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Integrate the reviewed develop snapshot with explicit PlatformVersion-to-GroveVersion maps and dependency/codec compatibility.

**Rules/checks:** Platform currently pins 6fc7e1e; develop is c401b504, workspace6.0.0 and bincode2.1.0. Grove V4 is not Platform PV4. Preserve old roots/cost behavior and reject new forms before activation.

**Cost drivers:** Upgrade migration, historical replay and new cost tables. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/Cargo.toml](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/Cargo.toml#L55); [Cargo.toml](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/Cargo.toml#L1)

N01.title: Identity lookup, keys and nonces
N01.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Use identity/key/contract-info queries for caller authorization and existing signed identity operations.

**Rules/checks:** Guest cannot mint identities, forge keys or bump nonces arbitrarily. Contract holdings remain separate; test replay, disabled keys, security levels and contract-specific nonce checks.

**Cost drivers:** Key/nonce/contract-info reads and native writes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs#L1)

N02.title: Identity credit balances and transfers
N02.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Reuse authorized native balance reads/transfers as the adapter basis for contract deposits/payouts.

**Rules/checks:** Use checked amounts and live affordability; honor recipient contract rules and atomic conservation. Identity debit requires its authorization, never mere visibility.

**Cost drivers:** Balance reads/writes and conservation updates. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs#L1)

N03.title: Contract credit buckets
N03.body:
**Surface:** New contract integration already selected. **Tasks:** CAP-08, CAP-14.

**Declare/do:** Add separate contract credit sum-tree buckets, spending rules and current-state queries/proofs.

**Rules/checks:** No keyless ordinary contract identity. Include zero/nonzero buckets, multiple recipients, freeze and wipes; both contracts must permit cross-contract movement.

**Cost drivers:** Bucket, authorization and total-supply accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/balances/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/balances/mod.rs#L1)

N04.title: Contract token buckets
N04.body:
**Surface:** New contract integration already selected. **Tasks:** CAP-08, CAP-14.

**Declare/do:** Extend typed token balance ownership to contract buckets and their spending/receiving rules.

**Rules/checks:** Respect token restrictions and all supply totals. Wiped issued tokens cease to exist; foreign holdings move to the specified identity vestige.

**Cost drivers:** Token buckets, supply checks and lifecycle moves. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/balance/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/balance/mod.rs#L1)

N05.title: Asset-lock credits and partial consumption
N05.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Retain native Core asset-lock validation, spent tracking and partial-use accounting.

**Rules/checks:** No arbitrary credit issuance or direct contract-to-Core unlock. Test duplicate/outpoint proofs, partial consumption and mixed batch conservation.

**Cost drivers:** Proof checks, spent records and remaining credit accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/asset_lock/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/asset_lock/mod.rs#L1)

N06.title: Identity and address withdrawals
N06.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Keep existing authorized identity/address withdrawal queues and limits.

**Rules/checks:** Contract direct Core unlock is excluded. Guest cannot enqueue unsigned withdrawals or bypass native rate/fee rules; existing recovery remains.

**Cost drivers:** Queue storage, fee selection and pool accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/withdrawals/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/withdrawals/mod.rs#L1)

N07.title: Address balances, nonces and funding routes
N07.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Account for existing address funding/transfers and identity creation/top-up routes in conservation and adapters.

**Rules/checks:** These native routes are not automatically new contract holdings. Explicitly reject unsupported contract-to-address routes until designed; preserve signatures/nonces.

**Cost drivers:** Address inputs/outputs, proof checks and balance writes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/address_funds/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/address_funds/mod.rs#L1)

N08.title: Token definitions and supply
N08.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Use token conventions, base/max supply, metadata, destination and configuration validation.

**Rules/checks:** Contract rules compose with native token authorization; cannot bypass supply caps, decimal bounds or referenced group checks. Version configuration changes.

**Cost drivers:** Definition bytes, supply writes and validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_configuration/v0/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_configuration/v0/mod.rs#L38)

N09.title: Token mint and mint-many
N09.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized minting and native multi-recipient mint operations.

**Rules/checks:** Enforce manual mint rules, max supply, destination restrictions and frozen-receipt behavior; test atomic rollback across recipients.

**Cost drivers:** Recipients, balances, supply and history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/mint_many/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/mint_many/mod.rs#L1)

N10.title: Token burn and destroy frozen funds
N10.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized burn/destroy-frozen-funds intents.

**Rules/checks:** Distinguish normal holder burn from privileged destruction. Maintain supply and mandatory history; wipe destruction of all issued tokens is additional lifecycle work.

**Cost drivers:** Destroyed holdings, supply/history updates. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/burn/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/burn/mod.rs#L1)

N11.title: Token transfer and balance reads
N11.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose transfer/read/query with contract bucket adapters.

**Rules/checks:** Enforce pause/freeze and allow-transfer-to-frozen settings, sender/receiver rules and lossless amount encoding. Test multi-step same-batch conservation.

**Cost drivers:** Balances, restrictions and transfer history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/transfer/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/transfer/mod.rs#L1)

N12.title: Token freeze, unfreeze and emergency state
N12.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose native authorized freeze/unfreeze and pause/emergency operations.

**Rules/checks:** Native token state and smart-contract execution freeze are separate checks. Frozen actions reject, with no bypass through other host methods.

**Cost drivers:** Status/balance writes and mandatory history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/freeze/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/freeze/mod.rs#L1)

N13.title: Token direct purchase and pricing
N13.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized price changes and direct purchases using native marketplace rules.

**Rules/checks:** Check exact pricing, supply, buyer affordability, payment destination and history. This does not select the deferred native auction project.

**Cost drivers:** Price lookup, mint/transfer, payment and history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/direct_purchase/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/direct_purchase/mod.rs#L1)

N14.title: Token perpetual and programmed distribution
N14.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Reuse distribution definitions, reward moments/types/functions and native claim/release machinery.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve supported functions and epoch/time semantics; no wall-clock nondeterminism. Contract recurring calls use the separate agreed pay-as-executed model.

**Cost drivers:** Recipients, due releases, claims and scheduled processing. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/distribution/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/distribution/mod.rs#L1)

N15.title: Token histories and configuration changes
N15.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose existing history settings and permitted configuration mutations.

**Rules/checks:** Some native events always record history even when optional categories are disabled. Preserve change-control rules; receipt disable cannot suppress required token records.

**Cost drivers:** History documents/indexes and configuration validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_keeps_history_rules/v0/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_keeps_history_rules/v0/mod.rs#L15)

N16.title: Groups, action records and change control
N16.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Use identity/group authorization, weighted members, required power and native accumulated group actions.

**Rules/checks:** No assumption that a contract can itself hold group membership; that is deferred. Prevent duplicate power, expired/unauthorized actions and unapproved rule changes.

**Cost drivers:** Members, signatures, votes and action records. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/group/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/group/mod.rs#L1)

N17.title: Contested-resource voting and queries
N17.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Reuse existing polls, contestants, tallies, end-time indexes and resolution flows.

**Rules/checks:** Only authorized native actors vote. Existing contested-index polls retain native parameterized award rules. Separate contract governance uses strictly more than two-thirds of all active eligible evonodes and a one-week window with early approval after eligibility recheck.

**Cost drivers:** Poll storage, vote updates and finalization work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/votes/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/votes/mod.rs#L1)

N18.title: DPNS and system contracts
N18.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Retain system-contract validation, initialization, lookup and document rules.

**Rules/checks:** Contract-held names deferred. System schemas/root permissions cannot be changed by a generic tree API; group authorization is still allowed.

**Cost drivers:** System document/index lookup and native validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/system/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/system/mod.rs#L1)

N19.title: Shielded pool state
N19.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Account for existing note commitments, nullifiers, anchors, balances and native shield/unshield routes.

**Rules/checks:** Guest cannot forge notes/nullifiers or bypass proof/anchor validation. This does not add the deferred general ZK contract stage or approve a new contract shielded-balance model.

**Cost drivers:** Proof validation, append work, nullifiers and anchor maintenance. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/shielded/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/shielded/mod.rs#L1)

N20.title: Credit pools and total conservation
N20.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Include contract buckets and fees in existing processing/storage/system-credit pools and total balance checks.

**Rules/checks:** Wipe credits enter the current processing pool. Check mint/burn/withdrawal/shielded/address interactions, refunds and epoch transitions.

**Cost drivers:** Pool reads/writes and reconciliation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/credit_pools/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/credit_pools/mod.rs#L1)

N21.title: Prefunded specialized balances
N21.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Reuse native prefunded-balance storage where appropriate for approved fees/removal costs.

**Rules/checks:** Do not restore full recurring-execution prepayment. Define ownership/refunds and first-payment-failure drop cost for the new scheduling adapter.

**Cost drivers:** Queue/balance entries and prepaid removal accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/prefunded_specialized_balances/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/prefunded_specialized_balances/mod.rs#L1)

N22.title: Saved block transactions and execution status
N22.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Retain native saved transition/result lookups; implement receipts separately.

**Rules/checks:** Existing saved-block storage is not automatically a permanent execution receipt or a historical-proof API. Preserve replay/error classification.

**Cost drivers:** Saved bytes, retention and result proof handling. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/saved_block_transactions/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/saved_block_transactions/mod.rs#L1)

N23.title: Platform state, protocol votes and initialization
N23.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Retain native height/time/epoch/version initialization and upgrade vote machinery.

**Rules/checks:** Only protocol actions change these roots. Activation readiness uses the approved 80% entire active set and clamp(T,2min,1h) additional wait; membership and boundary details remain open.

**Cost drivers:** Protocol-state reads, vote records and initialization. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/platform_state/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/platform_state/mod.rs#L1)

## Operations and integration

O01.title: Database open, transactions and checkpoints
O01.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Drive owns storage lifetime, transactions, rollback/commit and checkpoint snapshots.

**Rules/checks:** No filesystem/database handle exposed to WASM. Test checkpoint consistency with the contract read view and atomic application; reuse native recovery.

**Cost drivers:** Transactions, checkpoint I/O and retained snapshots. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/mod.rs#L156)

O02.title: Replication, chunks and state synchronization
O02.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Include new tree/element/proof types in existing snapshot/chunk export/import and state sync.

**Rules/checks:** Reuse native indexed-sync transfer of primary and secondary trees, with their joint parent-root binding checked at finalization. Ordinary query-chunk rejection is distinct from indexed state sync. Test malformed/incomplete chunks, restart and restored current roots.

**Cost drivers:** Chunk bytes, reconstruction, checksums and disk. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/replication/indexed_sync.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/replication/indexed_sync.rs#L1)

O03.title: Integrity verification, repair and migrations
O03.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Use node-owned verify/migration/dump/load tooling to inspect all new layouts.

**Rules/checks:** Unsafe root replacement/dump-load stays outside guest ABI. Test back-reference/index inconsistencies and historical version compatibility; no new recovery gates imposed.

**Cost drivers:** Full traversal and administrative I/O. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/replace_subtree_root.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/replace_subtree_root.rs#L1)

O04.title: Caches and estimation helpers
O04.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-11, CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Keep contract/document caches, size estimation and generated path helpers inside Drive.

**Rules/checks:** Invalidate on updates and protocol changes; executable compiled caches are separate from canonical code. Cache hit/miss must not alter consensus results or fees.

**Cost drivers:** Cache memory and deterministic estimation assumptions. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/cache/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/cache/mod.rs#L1)

O05.title: Proof verification and client binding parity
O05.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-12, CAP-13, CAP-16.

**Declare/do:** Map every exposed result into proof verifier, DAPI, Rust/WASM/JS and mobile SDKs; preserve exact integers and type tags.

**Rules/checks:** Do not assume existing endpoints/bindings already expose every GroveDB query. Add vectors for positive, absent, tampered, wrong-root and unsupported-version results.

**Cost drivers:** Verification work, decoding limits and client conversion. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/verify/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/verify/mod.rs#L1)

O06.title: Contract calls, predicates and scheduling integration
O06.body:
**Surface:** New contract integration already selected. **Tasks:** CAP-14, CAP-16.

**Declare/do:** Apply the same capability checks through direct calls, predicates, nested calls and scheduled work.

**Rules/checks:** Current-state reads include earlier accepted transitions and same-transition effects in agreed order; native validation and affordability remain enforced. Latest visible cross-contract methods only; no old-version fallback. Nested rollback/reentry limits remain to specify.

**Cost drivers:** Shared computation/native-operation budgets and scheduled draining. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/state_transition_action/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/state_transition_action/mod.rs#L56)

O07.title: Freeze, wipe and permanent code lifecycle
O07.body:
**Surface:** New contract integration already selected. **Tasks:** CAP-14, CAP-16.

**Declare/do:** Apply contract rules and approved masternode-governed lifecycle over every capability family.

**Rules/checks:** Keep all code versions; deprecated warns, unsupported may stop running. Wipe credits to current pool, destroy issued tokens, move foreign tokens to vestige. Cover references, indexes, histories, queues and specialized data; vestige recovery requires a specific-transfer network vote exceeding two-thirds of all active eligible evonodes.

**Cost drivers:** Bounded cleanup, asset accounting, reference fan-out and retained code. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/config/v1/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/config/v1/mod.rs#L21)


## Supplemental implementation work packages

- [ ] **CAP-02 — Specify typed capability declarations and contract authority.** Choose document-schema extensions versus a typed collection interface; define namespace, rules, read/write methods, limits and privacy model. No raw system paths. Q36 (confirmed): Use simple persistence/index/rule attributes plus typed builders for advanced native features, producing one canonical manifest. Reject unsupported/conflicting declarations; native validation remains the authority. No unrestricted database paths. Q38 (confirmed): Private Rust fields and ACL checks are not encryption. Keep the private capability in the catalogue while encryption, key control, query visibility and proof behavior are separately specified before enabling its interface. Covers: T01 T02 T03 T13 T14 T15 T16 T17 R01 R03 R04 Q06 Q14. Prerequisites: none recorded.
- [ ] **CAP-03 — Complete native schema and index host adapters.** Reuse existing DPP/Drive validation, not duplicated validators; exercise all compatible and rejected flag/layout combinations. Q09 (confirmed): Contracts may parameterize contested indexes only through supported native declarations
